data.value.logicboolean.description: Advanced code to create conditionals and triggers
data.value.logicboolean.true.description: This value will meet the condition
data.value.logicboolean.false.descriptio: This value will not meet the condition
data.value.logicboolean.if.description: Start all logic booleans with if, unless just using booleans (true/false)
data.value.logicboolean.and.description: Connector. Adds another condition to the list. All conditions linked by this must be reached to return true.
data.value.logicboolean.or.description: Connector. Adds another condition to the list. Just one of the conditions linked must be reached to return true
data.value.logicboolean.not.description: Conditional. Reverts meaning of the next logic boolean. Useful to set negative conditions
data.value.logicboolean.less.description: Return true if number on left is smaller. Means less than next value
data.value.logicboolean.greater.descript: Return true if number on right is smaller. Means greater than next value
data.value.logicboolean.lessequal.descri: Return true if number on left is smaller or equal. Means less or equal than next value
data.value.logicboolean.greaterequal.des: Return true if number on right is smaller or equal. Means greater or equal than next value
data.value.logicboolean.equal.descriptio: Return true if number, unit, string, bool on both sides is the same. Means equal to next value
data.value.logicboolean.notequal.descrip: Return true if number, unit, string, bool on both sides different. Means different to next value
data.value.logicboolean.add.description: Add two numbers or join two strings. Means addition to this value
data.value.logicboolean.subtract.descrip: Subtract two numbers. Means subtraction to this value
data.value.logicboolean.divide.descripti: Divide two numbers. Means division of two values
data.value.logicboolean.multiply.descrip: Multiply two numbers. Means multiplication of two values
data.value.logicboolean.modulo.descripti: Divides two numbers and returns the remainder. Means a percentage of a value
